EMPLOYMENT GROWTH COMPARISON
Westmoreland Resources Most Probable (Scenario 1) production vs their high level (Scenario 2). Low Participation Rates (LEPR-1) and other Significant Crow Coal Development (AF-2)
Source: Mountain West Research, Inc. February 1976
Figure III-13 shows the population levels generated by the two scenarios under the conditions prescribed for Figure III-12.
Here again, the eventual Crow population is unaffected by coal development. However, under the conditions of Scenario 2, non-Crow population is projected to more than double between 1970 and 2000 (from 5788 to 12,234).
The increase in population resulting from the higher coal production levels tends to be proportional to the employment generated.

Increased population which is directly attributable to the higher level of employment (in Scenario 2) will be only 648 people or 6.6 percent above levels for Scenario 1.
